name: writer_agent
description: Generates and refines documents on various topics, creating clear and well-structured content.

skills.name: Document Generation
skills.description: Generate initial drafts on any topic with clear structure and comprehensive content.
examples: Generate a draft document on artificial intelligence
Create an initial version of a technical report
Write a first draft on climate change

skills.name: Document Refinement
skills.description: Refine existing documents based on feedback, improving clarity, structure, and quality.
examples: Refine a document based on critique feedback
Enhance document quality based on suggestions
